cancellation_summary: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 14 days (336 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund.
description: The Lagoon 380 is the perfect vessel for ultimate relaxation. With 4 cabins, interior tables & seating & the trampoline (netted) deck it’s a great option for a family gathering or friend group to spend the day on the water!
